title: ساعتی که به صفر نمی‌رسد
logline_fa: شمارش معکوس از ده شروع می‌شود، هر بار به یک می‌رسد و دوباره از ده برمی‌گردد؛ اما هر دور آرام‌تر می‌شود، تا جمله آخر معنی تازه‌ای پیدا کند: «هنوز وقت هست».
ratio_note: 9x16 first; 1x1 as a simple second ratio

protagonist.what: a big Persian-digit countdown inside a circle ring
protagonist.build: digits as text (faDigits), ring as SVG stroke-dashoffset, 3 loops, each loop with a different colour and ease
protagonist.state_change: anxious tight digits and ring -> relaxed rounded digits and warm colour; last frame equals first frame

beats.what: third loop slows, digits soften; ring stays open
copy on the ring and seamless return to start

payoffs.viewer_gets: a final beat fails to arrive at 1
jumps back to 10 with a wipe, not zero
the sentence stamps and the ring stays open

assets: Persian digits (faDigits), SVG ring, a stamp
kit sfx: clock tick, riser, reset sweep, wood stamp, bell

tests: digit change without per-char split cuts
acceptance: payoff offsets <= 5 ms including the tick grid
loop gate: first vs last frame diff < 2%
lab.risk: low; the loop seam must be exact
